message: which name(s) nothing of their own
$reason: The reference's named group around two texts that name themselves, and a button that names itself with a text inside it, which names nothing. What a control inside owns is its own — the options of a select, a button's busy bar — but a text a user lands on is no part of the button around it: it is a control of the group's, unnamed, and axe reports `label` (critical) and `nested-interactive` in three engines. Stopping at the first control on the way down, whatever it is, hides it.
